info.title: Neuraal API
info.description: Backend API for Neuraal — task/note management with AI features (summaries, auto-topic classification).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication endpoints (register, login, refresh, logout, me, recover)

tags.name: AI
tags.description: AI usage, guardrails, and action tracking

tags.name: Storage
tags.description: User storage usage and attachment limits

CookieAuth.name: access_token
CookieAuth.description: JWT access token sent as httpOnly cookie.

DevUserIdHeader.name: x-user-id
DevUserIdHeader.description: Temporary dev-only auth. Sends a fixed user ID. Will be replaced by BearerAuth (JWT) in production.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token via Authorization header (alternative to cookie auth).

details.description: Optional extra data (e.g. RATE_LIMITED: remaining, resetAt)

sortOrder.description: Display order within a day. Lower values appear first.

payload.description: Dynamic payload. May contain entryId, requestId, score, etc. depending on notification type.

AiActionType.description: Available AI action types for usage tracking and guardrails

AiUsageItem.description: Usage and limits for a single AI action in a given month

post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Uses the refresh_token cookie to issue new auth tokens. Old refresh token is rotated.
Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration. If the email exists, a reset token is created (but email is not sent in MVP).
Recalculates the embedding vector for a topic using Ollama. Useful after renaming.

200.description: List of entries for the given date

patch.description: Updates entry fields with optimistic concurrency (version check).
Bulk-updates sortOrder for all entries on a given date. The order of IDs in the array determines the new sort order (index 0 = first).

orderedIds.description: Entry IDs in desired display order (index 0 = first).

post.description: Enqueues an async AI summary generation. Subject to guardrails: rate limit (429), monthly quota (403), concurrency (409), max input (400). Returns 202 Accepted when accepted.

400.description: Validation or INPUT_TOO_LARGE (max input chars exceeded)

409.description: CONCURRENCY_LIMIT — another summary already in progress for this entry or user

429.description: RATE_LIMITED — too many requests (details may include remaining, resetAt)

post.summary: Request YouTube transcript for an entry (async)
post.description: Enqueues an async YouTube transcription. Subject to guardrails: rate limit (429), monthly quota (403), concurrency (409). Returns 202 Accepted when queued.

409.description: CONCURRENCY_LIMIT — another transcript already in progress for this user

429.description: RATE_LIMITED — too many requests per minute

post.summary: Extract text or describe an image attachment (OCR / vision)
post.description: Analyzes an image attachment using Ollama Vision. Mode 'scan' extracts text (OCR); mode 'describe' generates a description. Synchronous call. Subject to guardrails: rate limit (429), monthly quota (403), concurrency (409).

attachmentId.description: Attachment ID of the image to analyze

400.description: Validation error or INPUT_TOO_LARGE (image too large)

409.description: CONCURRENCY_LIMIT — another OCR request already in progress

429.description: RATE_LIMITED — too many OCR requests per minute

get.description: Returns current usage and limits for the authenticated user across all AI actions, or filtered by a single action. Returns an object with `month` and `items` array.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by a single AI action type. Omit to get all actions.

200.description: Usage and limits for the requested month

month.description: The month the usage data applies to

items.description: Usage and limits per AI action

get.summary: Get user storage usage and limits
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's current storage usage (total bytes) and configured limits (max per user, max per entry).

usedBytes.description: Total bytes currently used by the user's active attachments

maxUserStorageBytes.description: Maximum total storage allowed per user (in bytes)

maxEntryAttachmentBytes.description: Maximum total attachment size allowed per entry (in bytes)

post.description: Generates an embedding for the entry text, finds the best matching topic by cosine similarity, and assigns it if the score meets the threshold.

200.description: List of attachments with usage/quota info

get.summary: List pending reminders for an entry
get.description: Returns all pending reminders for the specified entry owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: The entry ID to filter reminders by

post.description: Creates a new reminder for an entry. When channel is 'whatsapp', AI guardrails are enforced: rate limit (429), monthly quota (403), concurrency (409).

403.description: QUOTA_EXCEEDED — monthly WhatsApp reminder limit reached

409.description: Conflict — duplicate reminder or CONCURRENCY_LIMIT for WhatsApp channel

429.description: RATE_LIMITED — too many WhatsApp reminder requests per minute

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Filter notifications created after this ISO datetime

post.description: Callback endpoint for n8n to deliver AI-generated summaries. Authenticated via HMAC signature (NOT x-user-id).

parameters.name: X-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in ms used for HMAC computation

post.description: Callback endpoint for n8n to deliver YouTube transcriptions. Authenticated via HMAC signature (NOT user auth).

parameters.name: X-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in ms used for HMAC computation

transcriptText.description: The transcribed text from the YouTube video

usage.description: Token usage reported by the transcription model (optional)

post.description: Creates an attachment record and returns a presigned PUT URL for uploading.
Marks an attachment as ready after successful upload to S3.
